People: Friedrich Christian Accum (author, Wikidata Q72378), died 1838. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Accum, Friedrich Christian, 1769-1838") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Description of the process of manufacturing coal gas : for the lighting of streets, houses, and public buildings : with elevations, sections, and plans of the most improved sorts of apparatus now employed at the gas works in London, and the principal provincial towns of Great Britain ... : with seven plates, London : Printed for Thomas Boys ..., 1819, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/descriptionofpro00accuuoft. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 95%, 100%, 87% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Friedrich Christian Accum, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
